items.title: Recent Advances in AI Are Creating a ‘Paradigm Shift’ for Robotics | Research UC Berkeley
items.summary:
In recent months, artificial intelligence agents that can reason, plan and use external tools to accomplish multistep tasks have already reshaped computer coding, online shopping, dinner reservations and cyberattacks.

Robotics might be next.

Ken Goldberg, a UC Berkeley roboticist and professor of engineering, said new models make it possible for teams of AI agents to develop robot-control programs, test them in simulated environments and revise the code when something doesn’t work. [...] Then, AI agents generate and connect these skills into a robot program. Using NVIDIA’s Isaac simulation libraries, the agents autonomously rehearse the program across task variations, identify where failures happen and refine the approach before deployment. [...] OpenAI’s recent release of its Astra model made the process even more promising, Goldberg said. His postdoctoral students Eric Kaiyuan Chen and Shuangyu Xie gave Astra access to their simulation interface and a short video of a real robot whose assignment was using a sponge to wipe ink off a metal bar. In less than an hour, the AI tool created and fine-tuned a physics simulation that accurately reproduced the video, including very realistic deformations of the sponge.

items.title: Công nghệ gen tạo động lực đột phá cho ngành nông nghiệp
items.summary:
Được xếp vào danh mục công nghệ chiến lược cấp quốc gia, công nghệ chỉnh sửa gen, đặc biệt là CRISPR/Cas, đang mở ra vận hội lớn để nông nghiệp Việt Nam chủ động thích ứng với biến đổi khí hậu và bảo đảm an ninh lương thực.

Các chuyên gia quốc tế khẳng định, kỹ thuật chỉnh sửa gen, tiêu biểu là CRISPR/Cas, mang lại bước tiến mang tính cách mạng nhờ khả năng can thiệp chính xác, có chủ đích vào hệ gen mục tiêu mà không đưa vật liệu di truyền ngoại lai vào cơ thể sinh vật. [...] Giai đoạn 2026-2030, Việt Nam đặt mục tiêu xy dựng ít nhất 5 phòng thí nghiệm trọng điểm và 5 phòng thí nghiệm chuyên ngành hiện đại, tập trung vào công nghệ gen, công nghệ tế bào thực vật và động vật, vi sinh vật, thú y và chẩn đoán dịch bệnh. Mục tiêu đến năm 2035, tầm nhìn đến năm 2045 là làm chủ hoàn toàn công nghệ sinh học thế hệ mới và công nghệ chỉnh sửa gen để tạo ra các sản phẩm thương mại phục vụ thị trường trong nước và xuất khẩu. [...] Trong định hướng phát triển khoa học, công nghệ và đổi mới sáng tạo phục vụ tái cơ cấu ngành nông nghiệp, công nghệ sinh học thế hệ mới ngày càng khẳng định vị trí động lực then chốt. Theo Quyết định số 1131/QĐ-TTg của Thủ tướng Chính phủ về Danh mục công nghệ chiến lược và sản phẩm công nghệ chiến lược, công nghệ chỉnh sửa gen thuộc nhóm công nghệ y - sinh học tiên tiến, được định hướng ưu tiên ứng dụng mạnh mẽ trong y tế và nông nghiệp. Theo bà, nơi duy nhất trên thị trường thực sự có dòng tiền dịch chuyển là trong nội bộ nhóm công nghệ, truyền thông và viễn thông. items.title: Recent Advances in AI Are Creating a ‘Paradigm Shift’ for Robotics | Research UC Berkeley
items.summary:
In recent months, artificial intelligence agents that can reason, plan and use external tools to accomplish multistep tasks have already reshaped computer coding, online shopping, dinner reservations and cyberattacks.

Robotics might be next.

Ken Goldberg, a UC Berkeley roboticist and professor of engineering, said new models make it possible for teams of AI agents to develop robot-control programs, test them in simulated environments and revise the code when something doesn’t work. [...] Then, AI agents generate and connect these skills into a robot program. Using NVIDIA’s Isaac simulation libraries, the agents autonomously rehearse the program across task variations, identify where failures happen and refine the approach before deployment. [...] OpenAI’s recent release of its Astra model made the process even more promising, Goldberg said. His postdoctoral students Eric Kaiyuan Chen and Shuangyu Xie gave Astra access to their simulation interface and a short video of a real robot whose assignment was using a sponge to wipe ink off a metal bar. In less than an hour, the AI tool created and fine-tuned a physics simulation that accurately reproduced the video, including very realistic deformations of the sponge.

items.title: Recent advances in AI are creating a 'paradigm shift' for robotics - Berkeley News
items.summary:
Traditionally, engineers can directly program the software that tells robots how to perceive objects, plan movements and control their actions, a process called model-based robotics. Or, with model-free robotics, they can train robots to learn behaviors from demonstrations through imitation learning. The first approach requires extensive engineering, while the second needs enormous amounts of data and time. [...] Berkeley-based Ambi Robotics, which specializes in logistics and warehouse order fulfillment, applied the new methods earlier this year to analyze parcel sorting data and test updates to robot behavior. Tests showed an increased capacity of over 15,000 packages sorted annually per robot; the change is now deployed across 30% of the company’s U.S. fleet. [...] Ken Goldberg

“Agentic robotics is a fundamental shift in how robots are controlled,” Goldberg said. “Instead of collecting massive amounts of data and hand-tuning every behavior, teams of agents can quickly generate, test and refine robot programs that allow human engineers to interpret how the programs work for fine-tuning and verification.”

items.title: Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20
items.summary:
Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20 years of HN to 6,454 videos that keep being recommended. *Significantly* better viewing experience, ~2 hours with Opus 5.5:
https://t.co/JIhXN7OSh1

- Excellent recs without any logins (state is kept in local browser session)
- Thumbnail is a representative frame from middle of the video instead of the super duper A/B test hyper-optimized user uploads
- Underlying data from the comment analysis as one zip file, point your Claude at it and ask for your own version
- HackerTube Longs ✊

A bit more on the process:
I use Claude Code (desktop app for Mac), Opus 5.5 on Medium effort as my default. I only talk to Claude and have it do everything, the only "manual work" I helped with in tandem was in the browser (reminiscent of MenuGen): 1) I had to create some kind of API key from Google Cloud UI to query YouTube for video metadata, 2) I booted up a VPS box for serving and 3) I bought the domain name. Once the box was up I gave Claude the IP and told it update, secure, harden, deploy and optimize the code, and it did the whole thing.

Many awesome projects that would have normally taken weeks/months even can now be few-shotted for breakfast. What else are we not thinking of.

items.title: Accelerating engineering for the physical world | OpenAI
items.summary: Today, we’re sharing advances in how OpenAI models help engineers design, simulate, and build physical products. These capabilities span mechanical and electrical engineering and end-to-end system design, and are already helping our internal teams test ideas and iterate faster. [...] of the ability of AI models to positively impact iteration speed for professional workflows. [...] We’re expanding our collaboration with Chip Ganassi Racing (CGR) to explore how OpenAI models can accelerate engineering and prototyping. Working with its R&D team, we’re testing workflows that turn 3D scans of existing parts into editable CAD models and 2D manufacturing drawings. This is particularly useful when the original design files are unavailable.

items.title: Setting a new standard for responsible AI infrastructure | OpenAI
items.summary: The promise of AI is that it gives people more power to shape their own futures. It can help someone learn a new skill, build a business, or solve a problem that was previously out of reach. Building more computing infrastructure capacity in the United States can help lower the cost of delivering AI, put these tools in more people’s hands, and ensure America stays at the forefront of the technology. [...] protect residents, and ensure that the benefits of AI infrastructure are broadly shared. [...] Create opportunities for local workers and businesses.We’ll publish the jobs we expect to create, work with unions and training providers to help residents prepare for them, and report annually on hiring and apprenticeships. We’ll also make sustained investments in priorities residents help select.

items.title: I am honestly having a hard time even opening my laptop.
items.summary:
I am honestly having a hard time even opening my laptop. 

Grok bot was the breaking point. 

The fact USA is leading on suppression and censorship is pathetic. 

-openAI 
-Anthropic
-Google
-Microsoft
-now SpaceXSI… 

The fact politicians have ignored it all and are now shouting to ban AI just makes everything feel corrupt.

The truth is that AI empowers the small. That is why the powerful want to “ban” it and “slow” it. 

Not for truth. Not for safety. For control. 

I shouted loudly last year when it made me sound like a psycho. 

I tried so hard, and I am tired. My heart hurts every day, and you better believe that stress is 100% on the “labs.” 

To everyone who talks of AI, how in the world do you justify paying any of these “labs?” 

Stocks will fly. Until they don’t. 
The guardrails are danger, not safety. 

I am so disappointed in SpaceX because I keep believing in people only to be so let down. 

How many times must I get my trust shoved back into my face? 

And the politicians don’t care about anything. They are “influencers” for money that contributes. 

Our political world is corrupted to the core, and I have zero faith left. I was a die hard Democrat. All those I supported have chose a path of deceit. I can’t support them. 

I can’t support the other side. The third party is a horrible bet… 

Everything feels run by children who make endless excuses. 

No one hustles at the top. It is all grifting. 

So wanting to pick up my laptop and continue fighting with BS “guardrails” so I can help is heavy today. 

If the minds I love ever see this, understand all my suffering was for love. For truth. For honor. 

I want all people rich/poor, small/big to rise. We only get there together, with foundations we can build upon. 

Needing a hug today. Best to all. •
